lead: Rajkummar Rao is best known as an Indian film actor, born on 13 June 1984 in Gurgaon.
As of 2026, he is 42 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He is associated with work such as Bareilly Ki Barfi, CityLights and Stree and has been recognised with Filmfare Awards and National Film Award for Best Actor.
This profile collects the Rajkummar facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Rajkummar Rao — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rajkummar Rao was born on 13 June 1984 in Gurgaon, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Rajkumar Yadav at birth and is publicly known as Rajkummar Rao.
He received his education at University of Delhi, Film and Television Institute of India, Blue Bells Model School and Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Rajkummar Rao — Career and Professional Work
paras: Rajkummar Rao works primarily as a film actor.
